_how: Blob numbers from: scripts/gauge-dial.py blobs <p51-017.png> <dir> alt 141 141 90 120 140 (p51-017 = pdfimages -j -f 51 -l 51 image 017, converted to PNG). Blob 4 (100 ft) is merged with the needle and left out; 9, 12, 16, 19, 24, 30, 35, 41, 48, 53, 59 are numerals, needle or flag. Then: scripts/gauge-dial.py fit <p51-017.png> <dir> <this file>.
